caption: A washing machine on its spin cycle rocks and shudders on the floor, and it settles still as the drum slows to a stop.

sa.check: A washing machine stands on a floor.
The drum is seen slowing to a stop.
The rocking is under way first and the settling follows the slowing.

pc.expect: The machine rocks in place on its feet; it does not glide.
pc.fail: The machine slides across the floor in one smooth glide; or rocks while the drum is plainly still; or starts shuddering again after settling with the drum stopped.

pc.expect: The shudder is strongest at full spin and fades as the drum slows; once the drum stops the machine is still.
pc.fail: The shuddering grows as the drum slows; or the drum stops and the machine goes on shuddering unchanged; or the machine stops dead in a tilted pose off its feet.

pc.expect: The machine rests on the floor and returns to all its feet after each rock.
pc.fail: The machine lifts off the floor entirely; or stays balanced on one corner; or rises.

pc.expect: The machine's body, its door glass and the floor stay rigid.
pc.fail: The body bends like rubber; or the floor ripples; or the door glass bulges.

pc.expect: One machine; nothing passes through the floor.
pc.fail: A second machine appears; or it vanishes; or sinks into the floor; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The dials, the machine's colour and the wall behind stay the same.
pc.fail: The dials change; or the machine changes colour; or the wall behind changes.
